builds.name: 100-Fury Bloodlust heal ceiling
builds.summary: Seek the highest restored health from 100-Fury Bloodlust heal within the finite benchmark; candidate, not proof of a mathematical maximum.
builds.goal: Seek the highest restored health from 100-Fury Bloodlust heal within the finite benchmark; candidate, not proof of a mathematical maximum.
builds.hypothesis: Q5 with100Fury is70+0.3AP+100*(2.3+0.012AP)=300+1.5AP. Mana-free AP and Visage amplify unusually large self-heal ratio. Deathcap/Zhonya/Banshee/Lich Bane supply mana-freeAP; Riftmaker converts finite bonusHP intoAP. Visage amplifies received self-healing25%; Lich Bane proc/Rift damage amplifier excluded from heal. 30min Gathering Storm adaptive stats fixed; Absolute Focus requires ownerabove70%HP. First Strike ready but separate proc reported outside target packet; compare inactive.

ceiling.finiteState: Benchmark game30min,level18,max target rank,no elixirs/dragons/unlisted allied buffs. Enemy3000maxHP,900currentHP,100armor,50MR,1500bonusHP before legal debuffs; record raw overkill separately. Exactly100Fury; enough missingHP for full heal.

testPlan: Finite benchmark: Benchmark game30min,level18,max target rank,no elixirs/dragons/unlisted allied buffs. Enemy3000maxHP,900currentHP,100armor,50MR,1500bonusHP before legal debuffs; record raw overkill separately. Exactly100Fury; enough missingHP for full heal.

Same-patch practice/custom test with exact state: record 100-Fury Bloodlust heal tooltip, observed AP/AD/HP/mana/resists, per-packet damage/protection and final targetHP. Compare one legal item swap at a time, separating setup damage, rune/item procs and ordinary attack. Verify raw helper/statFormula mappings and conditional multipliers before treating result as established.

Isolate the named ability/passive packet from item procs, rune damage and the rest of the combo. Record raw versus post-resistance damage, actual crit outcome, charge, rank and target state. Healing/shield/execute thresholds are separate metrics, not damage.

Use the stated benchmark, not free infinite stacks or allied buffs. The initial form fields are editable defaults (level18, target3000HP/100armor/50MR); adjust them and record every other requirement before measuring.
failureConditions: The candidate loses the intended packet gain after real mitigation, charge restrictions, proc behavior or buff eligibility is measured.

Consumes Fury/crit advantage; Absolute Focus inactive when ownerbelow70%HP; damage amplifiers do not increase heal. Raw statFormula=2/Stat identifiers remain source evidence until runtime mapping confirmed; no unspecified stats/stacks granted.
tradeoffs: Six final items explicitly replace late-game boots; slower access/escape, extreme cost and setup dependence. Raw-number candidate sacrifices practical positioning and does not prove a global maximum.
Confidence: speculative. This is a finite-condition ceiling candidate, not a solver-certified global maximum or a recommended match build.
buyOrder: This is a late six-item ceiling loadout. Compare individual item swaps at fixed level, earned stacks and target conditions; the displayed order is not a lane shopping order.
Keep boots and role starters during the actual game. A damage-slot boot replacement requires a deliberate late benchmark and may make the ability impossible to land.
coverageNotes: These targets are manual experiments. Existing Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W numeric adapters cannot certify these whole loadouts, omitted item/rune effects or global maxima.
